definitions.gloss: preliminary figure; flash estimate; initial report value
definitions.explanation: A provisional numerical value released quickly after data collection, before thorough verification. Commonly used for economic indicators like GDP, trade statistics, and employment figures that are published in stages — first as a preliminary estimate, then revised.

examples.japanese: {速報値|そくほうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
GDP⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{速報値|そくほうち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前期比|ぜんきひ}⟦プラス→プラス：00346_purasu⟧0.5%だった。
examples.english: The preliminary GDP figure was plus 0.5% compared to the previous quarter.

examples.japanese: {速報値|そくほうち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あくまで→あくまで：06713_akumade⟧⟦{暫定的|ざんていてき}→暫定的：06712_zanteiteki⟧なもので、{確定値|かくていち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}される→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The preliminary figure is strictly provisional; the final value is scheduled to be announced next month.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧ (flash report, breaking news) and {値|ち} (value, figure). This term appears frequently in news broadcasts and financial reporting. The {速報値|そくほうち} is typically followed by a {改定値|かいていち} (revised figure) and finally a {確定値|かくていち} (final/confirmed figure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速報値|そくほうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to announce the preliminary figure
- {速報値|そくほうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上方修正|じょうほうしゅうせい}→上方修正：24821_jouhoushuusei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to revise the preliminary figure upward
- {速報値|そくほうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下方修正|かほうしゅうせい}→下方修正：19864_kahoushuusei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to revise the preliminary figure downward

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧: flash report, bulletin — the quick-release report itself
- {確報値|かくほうち}: confirmed report value — the finalized figure
- {確定値|かくていち}: final confirmed value — the last revision
- {改定値|かいていち}: revised value — the intermediate revision
